$fixture.description: A terminal successful result. process_exit_validated is fixed true because completion requires both a committed result and a validated process exit (invariant LC-05).

report.summary: Connection-pool exhaustion in checkout-api, triggered by upstream inventory-service latency, is the most likely cause.

findings.statement: Pool acquisition timeouts precede every observed 503 by 2-4 seconds.

uncertainties: No inventory-service logs were supplied, so the cause of its latency increase cannot be determined.
recommendations: Reduce the upstream timeout below the pool acquisition timeout.
